title: Debug · evidence, dispositions and safe handoff
subtitle: Investigation is read-only. A validated packet carries evidence; the original caller still owns permission to act.

nodes.title: Keep actual request scope
nodes.body:
Diagnosis only → recommend and stop
Existing fix authority stays bounded
No code, tests or configuration edits
No compulsory new onboarding

nodes.title: Capture symptom + applicability
nodes.body:
Observed / expected + cited sources
Known reproduction state and limits
Actual worktree, source/build/runtime IDs
Unknowns stay unknown

nodes.title: Check real discriminators
nodes.body:
Distinct mechanisms; no fixed hypothesis quota
CONFIRMED / REFUTED / INCONCLUSIVE
Capture limits constrain absent-event claims
New safe discriminator → bounded further check

nodes.title: Choose one disposition
nodes.body:
Retain multiple supported causes
Keep separate authority blockers
Missing access is not design
Non-reproduction is not closure

nodes.title: confirmed_code_defect
nodes.body:
Supported causal mechanism
Current expected behavior
Concrete regression obligation
Candidate fix, not repair consent

nodes.title: confirmed_noncode_cause
nodes.body:
Supported external / operational cause
Existing owner, or owner unknown
Next evidence / access action
No forced source patch

nodes.title: design_question
nodes.body:
Actual competing expectations
Maintainer’s intended-behavior choice
Optional later attributed ADR
No automatic ADR creation

nodes.title: no_action
nodes.body:
Positive applicable closure evidence
No remaining work in this scope
No default task or board note
No state mutation

nodes.title: unresolved
nodes.body:
Known facts + missing discriminator
Owner and next action when known
Resume condition or prerequisite
No invented cause or no-action verdict

nodes.title: Transient debug-handoff/1.0.0
nodes.body:
Symptom, expectation, evidence and limits
Source binding, causes and disposition
Regression oracle when a code defect exists
Measure UTF-8 size before first validation
nodes.detail: Exact schema identifier is codearbiter.debug-handoff/1.0.0. Keep the packet in the active session. Input is at most 65,536 bytes; only explicit evidence-preserving compaction before first validation is allowed. No new automatic per-turn injection or persistent case directory.

nodes.title: Installed helper: validate
nodes.body:
Python 3 -B, absolute installed helper
Bounded packet bytes on stdin
Exit 0 + valid true + no errors → transfer
Invalid / unavailable → stop, no fallback
nodes.detail: Resolve debug-handoff.py from the trusted loaded package. Exit 2 is invalid input; exit 3 or an unavailable helper blocks validated transfer. Do not silently repair a rejected packet, retry another interpreter, or continue an unvalidated repair.

nodes.title: Recheck current evidence
nodes.body:
Actual repository and worktree
Source/runtime identity and cited evidence
Commit + index + dirty working state
Relevant drift → revalidate or block

nodes.title: Check actual caller authority
nodes.body:
Only code defect → fix is eligible
Independent repair permission required
Diagnosis-only stops at recommendation
Packet intent cannot authorize work

nodes.title: Stop or return the supported result
nodes.body: Invalid packet, unavailable helper, changed evidence, non-code/design/no-action/unresolved result, or absent repair authority: no dependent code repair.

nodes.title: Deliver context; prove target RED
nodes.body:
Actual fix-author scoped input first
Named regression at the production layer
Fail for the defect’s precise reason
No feature artifact invented

nodes.title: Minimum authorized fix
nodes.body:
Cause and scope from current evidence
Change only after valid target RED
Then green, obligations, coverage, lint
No setup/import failure as a substitute

nodes.title: Current regression evidence
nodes.body:
Read real output and exit codes
Preserve failing-before / passing-after
Original caller’s TDD gates remain
No acceptance by author assertion

nodes.title: Separate delivery authority
nodes.body:
Verified change is not a commit
/commit retains nine gates
PR, merge and release are separate
No automatic outward publication

nodes.title: Resume only from available evidence
nodes.body:
Validate retained bytes; recheck actual worktree, source, runtime and dirty-state applicability.
If context was lost, say so and reconstruct from accessible citations. Do not claim durable memory
or silently replace a malformed packet with an unvalidated repair.

nodes.title: Concrete follow-up: its own /task authority
nodes.body:
A needed task needs separate authorization, action, provenance and completion evidence.
The existing task owner writes through taskwrite.py; debug never calls it by default.
A design question may lead to an attributed ADR later, never by automatic conversion.

edges.label: qualifying result + current evidence + original repair authority

panels.title: 01  /  INVESTIGATE THE OBSERVED CASE
panels.caption: Natural-language diagnosis and /debug select the same owner. An authorized /fix may invoke one bounded internal diagnostic prerequisite.

panels.title: 02  /  FIVE EXPLICIT OUTCOMES
panels.caption: Exactly one case disposition. Each retains its evidence and limits; none silently creates a task, ADR, repair or operational change.

panels.title: 03  /  TRANSFER EVIDENCE ONLY THROUGH A VALID HANDOFF
panels.caption: The transient packet is not a persistent case store. Validation checks structure, not truth, freshness, consumed context or permission.

panels.title: 04  /  ONLY AN AUTHORIZED, CURRENT CODE-DEFECT HANDOFF ENTERS REPAIR
panels.caption: Direct confirmed bugs can enter /fix without public debug. One internal diagnosis returns to the same fix attempt; never recursively retype public routes.

panels.title: 05  /  RESUME AND FOLLOW-UP WITHOUT INVENTED STATE
panels.caption: The summary is bounded and evidence-linked. The packet is not a memory service or a grant of authority to the next workflow.

notes.text: Human summary: at most 400 words excluding short locators. Packet: at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes. Neither is a new persistent case store.
